title: localfix: ParticipantListUpdate index base across one commit (decision .5.70 vs #161)
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.5.70: each ParticipantListUpdate's indices refer to the list before THAT update, applied in commit order (hub/components.rs:10-15, :145-215). rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#161 (2026-10-19): removal indices refer to the list at the end of the epoch in which the proposal appears, as with MLS Remove. Same result for one update per commit; different when a commit carries two or more ParticipantListUpdates (the second's indices). The rest of his rules already match mimid (out-of-range/duplicate index rejects the whole proposal; role change of a removed user rejected via DuplicateIndex; adding an existing user rejected). Decide (Mark): switch now to epoch-start indexing for every update in the commit, or keep .5.70 until the spec text (followup PR) settles it. If switching: regression test first with two updates in one commit; supersede .5.70 with a new decision bead.
